Subject: Clarifying Our Regular Project Review Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to clarify our routine project review process to ensure everyone is aligned and on the same page.

During our regular project reviews, which are held weekly on Thursdays at 3 PM, we aim to discuss the progress of ongoing projects, identify any challenges or roadblocks, and plan the next steps. It is important that all team members who are involved in the projects attend these meetings, as it provides a platform for transparency and collaboration. If you are unable to attend, please ensure that you have someone from your team in attendance
